source: Measured R8 source with aggregate diagnostics only; source-integrated-r8 is preserved.
interpretation: Inclusive wall durations overlap across nested operations and concurrent processes. They are not additive CPU costs or predicted savings. Maxima are lifetime bounds, not phase-isolated maxima.
native_lifetime_interpretation: Operation durations cover the installation bracket. Process CPU counters cover their entire native lifetimes, including preparation. Nested operations and concurrently running processes overlap.
